multi_deck.metric: Reported pooled mirror win rate (%), sampled policy, seat-swapped, Wilson 95% CI
multi_deck.opponent_note: Four fixed scripted teachers; 'mirror' = the model plays the same deck as the scripted opponent; the 4 mirror cells are pooled.
multi_deck.caveat: Local reported evaluation against four fixed scripted opponents. Every model remained below parity with the scripted teachers.

specialist.metric: Reported win rate (%), sampled policy, seat-swapped, Wilson 95% CI

audit.note: Separate 100-game recorded audit: every model win ended with the opponent unable to draw (deck-out), a legal win condition.

specialist.caveat: Single fixed opponent. The report flags this as exploitation of that opponent, not general playing strength; transfer to other opponents was untested in this report.
